src: If you got nothing better to do, I might need your help with something.
I'd say the steaks here are worth my life, but with all these Godhunters around I'm reconsidering.
Great. Here's the deal for you: I tell you how to get some of that meat the easy way, and you bring me a piece of it.
How dare you show your face to me?
Oh, I can smell it. You have found the flesh, haven't you?
How dare you? Give it to me.
Oh, you glorious piece of flesh.
I am going to enjoy this.
Here, take this as a thanks.
So, what do you do all day?
Hmmh? What else could there be?
What the hell? You have friends?
You want me to go look for someone?
Probably won't be easy though, considering your... circumstances.
What kind of animal are you?
That's me, human. What are you though?
No luck yet, sorry, but could you maybe help me talk to the Flesh Nexus?
Yeah, but, could you first help me out with talking to the Nexus?
Yes. This one looks interesting enough.
Swallow? You want to eat it?
Ehh. It's pretty sure it wants to eat you.
There's a high chance my shell is resilient enough to survive this. Could be an informative experiment.
But I could also be stuck in the bowels of this animal for years. Decades, even.
Thank you. Chances are high I might need that.
Ok. I'll leave you to it for now.
Hey, do you know how to talk to the flesh that's growing everywhere?
A sudden awareness of past and recent experiences washes over you.
Hey. Who are you? What are you doing here?
I live here and guard the Fleshkraken. Now, WHAT are you doing here?
Please don't attack me. I'm not hurting anyone. I'm just taking care of the Fleshkraken.
The Fleshkraken is my friend. But he doesn't talk much.
And I wish there were more people around here.
But it's important that someone takes care of the Kraken. So I'll just stay here.
I'm alright. Don't worry. But thanks for asking.
It's not mine. Look, you can talk to him, if you want.
He's a bit moody these days.
You think? I mean, he's stuck here. I suppose he might like to have someone to talk to other than me.
No, and I don't know how they got him in there in the first place. I just... I just take care of him.
Do you know of other beings that are similar to him?
I heard rumours. About an eye as big as a house. And mountains of flesh. But I don't know where they are.
Maybe you could ask around Tauris. It's to the east of here.
I would, if I had any weapon.
Phew. I'm glad. I won't hurt you either. I just care for the Fleshkraken.
I came from back there. The facility.
You came through the door? That's working?
Apparently. You know about the machines down there?
No. Didn't know there were any.
You can stay here if you want. I don't mind.
Go away. Leave me, you bastard.
The Flesh Nexus is calling you.
You try to reach out, but no one reacts to you.
You reach out, and there is something or someone reacting to you.
The sensation increases, and now you feel a thousand eyes fixed on you.
You try to speak, but have no voice.
The moment passes, and you feel the presence vanishing again.
You reach out and the Flesh Nexus is aware of you.
You let the flesh enter your mind.
The Nexus emits a warm feeling towards you, but remains silent.
You are standing in the light of the Mother. It would be appropriate to approach her Temple with reverence.
She might not be your mother, but she's a mother thousandfold. Show some respect.
She's the mother of the city. I think she's always been here. Might even be friends with the Collectors.
Mother is biding her time beneath us. She's all-seeing, all-caring. It's her call that we are hearing and that we have to follow through.
How do I get into the Temple?
I don't know. I am not sure that I would want to. It's Mother's realm and should be respected.
This machine is missing a Machine Core.
Some parts inside must have dislodged.
I've collected the worm. Nothing else to do here.
A food store? It's a banquet. It's my delightsome haute cuisine. From derinded and dry-aged to garnished with lard, to dulcified even.
It's here where I correspond with my meals. Better said, I nourish myself by pondering about all the possible meals I could be having.
Ahhh, how I long for a fresh set of giblets, savory and delicious.
But, full disclosure and everything, I also sell meat. Yes.
What is up with that worm in the pen?
I caught it to process it. To get something savory from it.
Or rather, Marcia caught it and was smart enough to sell it to me. She knows I have a rather advanced palate.
The problem is that I am unsure how to prepare this animal.
It has a rather slimy underside, which I adore, but its muscular back looks tasty, too.
I could keep it alive for that occasional smear of fat.
Maybe the animal is too wild though. Maybe I should just butcher it to get my fix of filet.
Isn't that the hardest thing in the world, making decisions like that?
I could help you making a decision about that animal.
Are you sure you are up for it?
I am a connoisseur of all things relating to taste.
Uhm. It's rather irregular for me to depend on someone else.
But I guess it's worth a try.
Ah, doesn't it exude something, I don't know, ripe and aromatic?
Here. Let me open the door.
I think you should set the animal free.
I have examined the worm. It's under a lot of stress.
I don't think it would give you some tender meat anyway.
And the worm looks kinda old.
Wouldn't it be better to be known for only the best and freshest stuff?
Now that you mention it, the animal looks kinda old. And frightened.
Alright. I'll set it free soon. I appreciate your opinion.
Ah, wait. You mean I should keep it alive for that slimy underside?
Yum. Look at this fine fatty underbelly.
{There's a smear of the fatty substance on her lips.}
I killed that worm for you.
What? You can't just kill a delicacy like that.
If we want its meat, we have to carefully gut and bone it for its most precious parts.
These parts here seem fine to me.
Aha. Yes, indeed. They look fine.
Do you know anything about this Titan Support System?
Is that the thing regulating the Titan's metabolism?
I guess so. Looks like it needs a new filter.
Oof. I'm no help with any mechanical task. Sorry.
Do you know where I could get a new filter?
I don't know that either. Sorry.
About that exquisite taste I am looking for...
Yes. It's right in front of us, potentially. Morrowmeat, the suffering Titan.
I think I got it already.
Could I have a piece of that?
I see. If you need something else, find me over at my old place.
So I just grab a bite from him?
No. Not yet. Not like that.
He used to provide the most savory and tender raw meat this side of the City walls.
But over time, right from when he was alone here, without Mother, he began descending into an abyss of personal darkness.
Can't help that people are using his flesh as their day-to-day meat.
You should find a way to make his living more comfortable.
That's the best way to extract the most exquisite taste experiences: Making sure the raw materials are well-cared for.
I don't know. Examine him. Talk to the guardians.
I've personally given up on him returning from that abyss.
But I know we would have the most exquisite piece of meat one could think of: Savored meat of a saved Titan.
Wait. What is that? Morrowmeat looks different.
He was really miserable the last time I saw him.
Now he's showing a vibrance, a joie de vivre even.
Although I could be mistaken in that regard. His flesh is glistening so much.
